::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/metrics"}
#docs
:::warning
This endpoint is deprecated. It keeps working within its API version.
:::

Deprecated. Replaced by `GET /v1/analytics` (one measure over one window, optionally split by one dimension) and `GET /v1/analytics/measures` (the discovery endpoint listing every measure it can answer). This endpoint keeps answering with an unchanged payload and will only be removed at a version boundary, announced ahead of time.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `metrics_rollup`. One of `metrics_rollup`. |
| `as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the figures were computed. |
| `totals_by_currency` | `array of object` | Totals across every business, per currency. |
| `businesses` | `array of object` | Metrics for each business. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Metrics roll-up |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/metrics" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
